'''Maximum Security Pod J-P8''' was a psychiatric unit in the [[Maximum Security Section]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. It was located in the [[Special Restraint Cells]] section of the prison.
